book: Second, the beneficiary name on the PI is 'Shenzhen Volt Tech Co.', but the bank account name is 'Shenzhen VoltTech Co., Ltd.'

family.ex: The main benefit of lithium batteries is a longer life.
family.ar: أهم ميزة في بطاريات الليثيوم إن عمرها أطول.
family.ex2: That benefit lowers the customer's replacement cost.
family.ar2: الميزة دي بتقلّل تكلفة التغيير على العميل.

family.ex: The hospital will benefit from a 5-year warranty.
family.ex2: We also benefit, because service visits are fewer.
family.ar2: وإحنا كمان بنستفيد، عشان زيارات الصيانة بتقل.

family.ex: Remote monitoring is beneficial for large data centres.
family.ar: المراقبة عن بعد مفيدة للداتا سنترات الكبيرة.
family.ex2: It is beneficial because faults are found early.

family.ex: The beneficiary name must match the bank account exactly.
family.ar: اسم المستفيد لازم يطابق الحساب البنكي بالظبط.
family.ex2: Otherwise the bank will reject the transfer.

syn.note: person or company named to receive a payment
syn.ex: Write the supplier as the payee on the payment order.
syn.ar: اكتب المورد كمستفيد في أمر الدفع.
syn.ex2: The payee's IBAN must be on the form too.
syn.ar2: الـ‎IBAN‎ بتاع المستفيد لازم يبقى على الفورم كمان.

syn.note: general word for anyone who receives something
syn.ex: The recipient of the DHL envelope is our purchasing office.
syn.ar: مستلم ظرف ‎DHL‎ هو مكتب المشتريات عندنا.
syn.ex2: Add the recipient's phone number, or DHL may hold it.
syn.ar2: ضيف رقم تليفون المستلم، وإلا ‎DHL‎ ممكن توقفه.

syn.note: the person or company that owns the account
syn.ex: The account holder is Shenzhen VoltTech Co., Ltd.
syn.ar: صاحب الحساب هو ‎Shenzhen VoltTech Co., Ltd‎.
syn.ex2: The account holder's name must appear on the PI exactly.
syn.ar2: اسم صاحب الحساب لازم يظهر على الـ‎PI‎ بالظبط.

ant.ex: Nile Power Solutions is the payer of the deposit.
ant.ar: ‎Nile Power Solutions‎ هي اللي بتدفع العربون.
ant.ex2: The payer usually pays local bank charges.
ant.ar2: اللي بيدفع عادةً بيتحمل مصاريف البنك المحلية.

ctx: The bank rejected our transfer. The beneficiary name on the PI did not match the supplier's bank account name.
ctx_ar: البنك رفض التحويل بتاعنا. اسم المستفيد على الـ‎PI‎ مكانش مطابق لاسم الحساب البنكي بتاع المورد.

quiz.s: The ___ name must match the bank account exactly.
quiz.ar: اسم المستفيد لازم يطابق الحساب البنكي بالظبط.

quiz.s: Our customers ___ from fast service visits.
quiz.ar: عملاءنا بيستفيدوا من زيارات الخدمة السريعة.

quiz.s: Lithium batteries are ___ for long backup times.
quiz.ar: بطاريات الليثيوم مفيدة لأوقات الباك أب الطويلة.

book: The bank rejected it for two reasons.

family.ex: The bank rejected our transfer request this morning.
family.ar: البنك رفض طلب التحويل بتاعنا النهارده الصبح.
family.ex2: They rejected it because the PI was not stamped.

family.ex: We received a rejection notice from the bank.
Three rejected batteries were sent back to the supplier.
family.ex2: Rejected items are kept in quarantine first.
family.ar2: الحاجات المرفوضة بتتحط في العزل الأول.

syn.note: say clearly you won't do or give something
syn.ex: The supplier refused to pay the bank charges.
syn.ex2: He refused because the PI says charges are ours.
syn.ar2: رفض عشان الـ‎PI‎ بتقول المصاريف علينا.

syn.note: polite no to an offer or invitation
syn.ex: We politely declined the extra discount offer.
syn.ex2: We declined it because it needed a bigger MOQ.
syn.ar2: رفضناه عشان كان محتاج حد أدنى أكبر.

syn.note: informal no to an offer or request
syn.ex: The client turned down our first quotation.
syn.ar: العميل رفض أول عرض سعر قدمناه.
syn.ex2: He turned it down because of the long lead time.

ant.ex: The bank accepted the corrected PI the next day.
ant.ar: البنك قبل الـ‎PI‎ المصححة تاني يوم.
ant.ex2: Once accepted, the transfer went out in hours.
ant.ar2: أول ما اتقبلت، التحويل خرج في ساعات.

ant.ex: Customs approved the documents after the lab test.
ant.ar: الجمارك وافقت على المستندات بعد اختبار المعمل.
ant.ex2: Once they approved them, we paid the duties.
ant.ar2: أول ما وافقوا عليها، دفعنا الجمارك.

steps.ex: We must decline your invitation to the expo this year.
steps.ar: للأسف لازم نعتذر عن دعوتك للمعرض السنة دي.
steps.ex2: Maybe we can join next year.

steps.ex: The customer refused to sign the delivery note.
steps.ar: العميل رفض يمضي على إذن التسليم.
steps.ex2: He refused because two cartons were damaged.

steps.ex: Customs rejected the UN38.3 summary for the wrong model.
steps.ar: الجمارك رفضت ملخص ‎UN38.3‎ عشان الموديل غلط.
steps.ex2: They need the right document before release.

ctx: The bank rejected our deposit transfer. The PI was not stamped, and the beneficiary name was wrong.
ctx_ar: البنك رفض تحويل العربون بتاعنا. الـ‎PI‎ مكانتش مختومة، واسم المستفيد كان غلط.

quiz.s: The bank sent a ___ letter for the transfer.
Customs ___ the invoice because the ACID number was missing.
quiz.ar: الجمارك رفضت الفاتورة عشان رقم الـ‎ACID‎ كان ناقص.

quiz.s: Three ___ batteries were sent back to the supplier.

book: It seems the intermediary bank deducted its charges.

family.ex: The intermediary bank deducted USD 45 from our transfer.
family.ar: البنك الوسيط خصم 45 دولار من تحويلنا.
family.ex2: So the supplier received less than the PI amount.
family.ar2: فالمورد استلم أقل من مبلغ الـ‎PI‎.

family.ex: The USD 45 deduction was for bank charges.
family.ar: خصم الـ45 دولار كان مصاريف بنك.
family.ex2: Please show the deduction clearly on the statement.
family.ar2: ياريت الخصم يبان واضح في كشف الحساب.

family.ar: هل رسوم الخدمة دي بتتخصم من الضرايب؟
family.ex2: Ask Nadia if it's deductible before you book it.
family.ar2: اسأل نادية لو بتتخصم قبل ما تسجّلها.

syn.note: maths: take one number from another
syn.ex: Subtract the deposit from the total to get the balance.
syn.ar: اطرح العربون من الإجمالي عشان تطلع الباقي.
syn.ex2: After you subtract it, the balance is USD 87,360.

syn.note: keep part of a payment, often for tax
syn.ex: Our customer withholds 1% tax from every invoice.
syn.ar: العميل بتاعنا بيخصم 1% ضريبة من كل فاتورة.
syn.ex2: He sends us the certificate for the withheld amount.

syn.note: informal: reduce a price or amount
syn.ex: Can you take off the delivery charge for this order?
syn.ar: ممكن تشيل مصاريف التوصيل من الأوردر ده؟
syn.ex2: If you take it off, we'll order today.

ant.ex: Please add the USD 45 to the balance payment.
ant.ar: من فضلك ضيف الـ45 دولار على باقي المبلغ.
ant.ex2: Adding it now avoids a separate transfer.

ctx: The supplier received USD 45 less than expected. The intermediary bank deducted its charges because we sent the transfer with SHA.
ctx_ar: المورد استلم 45 دولار أقل من المتوقع. البنك الوسيط خصم مصاريفه عشان بعتنا التحويل بـ‎SHA‎.

quiz.s: The bank made a USD 45 ___ for its charges.

quiz.ar: هل الرسوم دي بتتخصم من الضرايب؟

quiz.s: Our customers ___ 1% tax from each payment and send us the certificate.
quiz.ar: عملاءنا بيخصموا 1% ضريبة من كل دفعة وبيبعتولنا الشهادة.

book: To avoid delaying production, we suggest adding the USD 45 to the balance payment.

family.ex: The balance of USD 87,405 is due before shipment.
family.ex2: We will pay the balance against a copy of the B/L.

family.ex: The balance payment will be sent with OUR charges.
family.ex2: So VoltTech receives the full balance payment.

family.ex: Nadia balances the bank accounts every month end.
family.ar: نادية بتسوّي حسابات البنك كل آخر شهر.
family.ex2: She balances them before closing the books.

family.ex: The supplier's statement and ours are now balanced.
family.ar: كشف حساب المورد وكشفنا دلوقتي متطابقين.
family.ex2: A balanced statement means no open differences.
family.ar2: الكشف المتطابق معناه مفيش فروق مفتوحة.

meanings.m: the remaining amount still to pay
meanings.ex: We paid 30%; the balance is due before shipment.
meanings.ex2: The supplier sends the B/L after the balance arrives.
meanings.ar2: المورد بيبعت البوليصة بعد ما الباقي يوصل.

meanings.ex: Please check our USD balance before the transfer.
meanings.ar: من فضلك شوف رصيد الدولار قبل التحويل.
meanings.ex2: If the balance is low, we wait for collections.

meanings.ex: We balance the customer accounts at month end.
meanings.ar: بنسوّي حسابات العملاء آخر كل شهر.
meanings.ex2: Any difference must be explained before closing.
meanings.ar2: أي فرق لازم يتفسّر قبل القفل.

syn.note: plain, clear wording for any customer
syn.ex2: We'll transfer the remaining amount next week.

syn.note: the last instalment in a payment plan
syn.ex: The final payment is due after commissioning.
syn.ex2: After the final payment, the warranty starts.

syn.note: still unpaid, often late; used in collections
syn.ex: The outstanding amount on invoice 2245 is EGP 180,000.
syn.ar: المبلغ المستحق على فاتورة 2245 هو 180,000 جنيه.
syn.ex2: Please settle the outstanding amount this week.
syn.ar2: من فضلك سدّد المبلغ المستحق الأسبوع ده.

ant.ex: We paid a 30% deposit to start production.
ant.ex2: The deposit came first; the balance comes before shipment.
ant.ar2: العربون بيتدفع الأول؛ والباقي قبل الشحن.

ctx: We will add the USD 45 to the balance payment. The balance will be USD 87,405, sent with OUR charges.
ctx_ar: هنضيف الـ45 دولار على الدفعة الأخيرة. الباقي هيبقى 87,405 دولار، هيتبعت بمصاريف ‎OUR‎.

quiz.s: We paid 30% in advance; the 70% ___ is due before shipment.
quiz.ar: دفعنا 30% مقدم؛ والـ70% الباقية مستحقة قبل الشحن.

quiz.s: Please check our bank ___ before the transfer.
quiz.ar: من فضلك شوف رصيدنا في البنك قبل التحويل.

quiz.s: Nadia checks that the accounts are ___ at month end.
quiz.ar: نادية بتتأكد إن الحسابات متسوّية آخر الشهر.

book: We will transfer the deposit as soon as we receive it.

family.ex: The supplier asks for a 30% deposit by T/T.
family.ex2: Production starts only after the deposit arrives.
family.ar2: الإنتاج مش هيبدأ غير لما العربون يوصل.

family.ex: Please deposit the customer's cheque at Banque Misr today.
family.ar: من فضلك ودّع شيك العميل في بنك مصر النهارده.
family.ex2: Deposit it before 2 pm so it clears tomorrow.
family.ar2: ودّعه قبل 2 الضهر عشان يتصرف بكرة.

family.ex: The depositor's name must appear on the bank slip.
family.ar: اسم المودِع لازم يظهر على إيصال البنك.
family.ex2: Write the company as depositor, not your own name.

meanings.ex: We will send the deposit within five working days.
meanings.ar: هنبعت العربون خلال خمس أيام شغل.
meanings.ex2: Then VoltTech starts producing our modules.

meanings.m: put money into a bank account
meanings.ex: Ahmed will deposit the cash collections tomorrow.
meanings.ex2: He deposits them in the company's EGP account.

meanings.ex: The shipping line asks for a container deposit.
meanings.ar: الخط الملاحي طالب تأمين على الكونتينر.
meanings.ex2: We get the deposit back when the container returns.

syn.note: formal wording in contracts and bank forms
syn.ex: The contract requires a 30% advance payment.
syn.ex2: The bank form calls it an advance payment.

syn.note: first part of a big purchase or project
syn.ex: The hospital made a down payment on the UPS project.
syn.ex2: The rest is paid in three instalments.

syn.note: paying in full or part before delivery
syn.ex: The supplier wants 100% prepayment for small orders.
syn.ar: المورد عايز 100% دفع مقدم للأوردرات الصغيرة.
syn.ex2: Prepayment is risky if we don't know the supplier.
syn.ar2: الدفع المقدم فيه مخاطرة لو منعرفش المورد.

ant.ex: Finance made a cash withdrawal to pay the customs broker.
ant.ar: الحسابات سحبت كاش عشان تدفع للمخلّص.
ant.ex2: Every withdrawal needs the director's signature.

ctx: Production will not start until the deposit arrives. Please send a signed PI so we can transfer the deposit tomorrow.
ctx_ar: الإنتاج مش هيبدأ لحد ما العربون يوصل. من فضلك ابعت ‎PI‎ متمضية عشان نحوّل العربون بكرة.

quiz.s: The supplier asks for a 30% ___ by T/T.
Please ___ the cheque at Banque Misr today.
quiz.ar: من فضلك ودّع الشيك في بنك مصر النهارده.

quiz.s: For small orders, the supplier wants 100% ___ before shipping.
quiz.ar: للأوردرات الصغيرة، المورد عايز 100% دفع مقدم قبل الشحن.
